phase1_assignment.objective: Audit generic scientist-agent evidence packaging, reproducibility and handoff mechanisms that preserve observation/inference/uncertainty and exact continuation.

observations.mechanism: closest official pre-submission EvoScientist artifacts make failure-memory boundary metadata explicit, while receiver-side pruning still lacks a mandatory target applicability check
observations.evidence: The official EvoScientist tag v.0.0.1-rc.1 resolves to commit 388519755987256cbd0ecf4cd28d31b2c06fa2ea dated 2026-03-08, one day before arXiv submission. That revision delegates IDE/IVE/ESE to the external evo-memory skill. In the official EvoSkills repository, the 2026-03-08 commit 3e206a95a896fa3b33c1960a72df7bd46d4579a7 contains the evo-memory IVE protocol and memory schema. IVE records implementation failures with Requirements, Validation Plan, Evidence, Retry Guidance and Countermeasures, and fundamental failures with Evidence, Diagnostic Answers, Root Cause and Boundary Conditions. The same historical idea-tournament skill selects top-2 memory entries by Summary/Retrieval Tags and prunes branches that match a fundamental failure pattern. No mandatory receiver-side mechanism/assumption compatibility check or bounded target probe is specified before that pruning.
observations.scope: This is the closest official public pre-submission artifact lineage found, not proof that these exact commits were the revisions used for the published evaluation. The evo-memory protocol contains practical extensions beyond the paper's core binary IVE description.

observations.mechanism: PRAXIS provides matched biological-science evidence that structured negative cases plus applicability metadata reduce unsafe transfer, while the target-side reviewer/revalidation gate remains component-confounded
observations.evidence: PRAXIS evaluates 11 biological domain agents on 5 held-out tasks each under six fixed-output memory conditions (330 outputs). Unsafe recommendation rate falls from 0.5818 with no brain and 0.5455 with cases only to 0.3636 with cases plus negative cases and 0.2182 with full PRAXIS. The isolated cases-only to cases+negative comparison is about a 33.3% relative reduction (17/24 discordant wins, p about 0.064), with the direction reproduced under two additional models. PRAXIS negative cases record error causes, triggering conditions, repair strategies and prohibited transfer scopes; every memory object includes applicability/inapplicability conditions, interpretation limits, provenance/review status and version information. Adaptive retrieval downweights negative/inapplicable markers. Full PRAXIS also uses reviewer gates, but those gates are not isolated in the published memory ablation.
observations.scope: Direct matched evidence for negative-case memory in biological research; supporting but not isolated causal evidence for target-side revalidation itself.

observations.mechanism: PRAXIS schema slicing independently shows that routing success does not imply auditable handoff unless provenance is carried
observations.evidence: PRAXIS evaluates 16 cross-agent envelopes. Full nine-field envelopes achieve 100% routing and 100% audit completeness. Removing provenance preserves routing but drops audit completeness to 0%; payload-only and free-text deterministic parsing also yield 0% audit completeness. The envelope includes source_agent, target_agent, request_type, payload, callback, provenance, schema_version, timestamp and envelope_id.
observations.scope: Small curated handoff-envelope experiment; directly supports provenance as an independent audit requirement, not a claim about downstream scientific correctness.

inferences.proposal: Boundary metadata must be executable at the receiver. A failure-memory record may not prune, forbid or otherwise constrain a current scientific action merely because it contains Boundary Conditions or Requirements; the receiver must establish that the current target satisfies the record's applicable conditions and does not satisfy its invalidating conditions, with a bounded target probe when mechanism compatibility is uncertain. Otherwise the record stays advisory/hold.

Temporal proximity is not evaluation provenance. A paper/evaluation handoff should bind the claim to an exact evaluated implementation revision or artifact identity, plus a mechanism fingerprint when code is split across repositories; a near-date official tag/commit is supporting lineage until equivalence is established.

failure_memory_suite.preservation: unchanged 11-case baseline; planned extension was not started after post-freeze control-head drift

PRAXIS directly isolates negative-case memory but does not separately ablate the target-side reviewer/revalidation gate; causal credit for that gate remains unresolved.
No machine-checkable local suite extension was performed after repository head drift; existing 15-case and 11-case suites remain unchanged.
